text: Hello there everyone, happy Wednesday 😉Here is another Seedance 2.0 video, I used an MJ image for reference you can find it below plus the prompt for it 😉 https://t.co/SAK6ZS1XJO
content: Use a Midjourney (MJ) image as the reference input in Seedance 2.0 to guide the video generation.

thread_texts: And here is the image I used as reference plus the prompt for both image and video 😊 https://t.co/1t7YHDMqJ1

Usa una imagen de Midjourney (MJ) como entrada de referencia en Seedance 2.0 para guiar la generación de video.
